sloka: इत्युक्त्वा स तदा राम मुपवासं यतव्रतम् ।मन्त्रवत् कारयामास वैदेह्या सहितं मुनिः ॥२-५-११॥
transliteration: ityuktvā sa tadā rāma mupavāsaṁ yatavratam ।mantravat kārayāmāsa vaidehyā sahitaṁ muniḥ ॥2-5-11॥

translations.english: The ascetic (Vasistha) having thus spoken to Rama made him undertake fast along with Sita in accompaniment with sacred hymns.
